jobs.title: Sales / Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Own the sales motion at a Global AI Transformation Firm

XSparks is a Global AI Transformation Firm.

As Director of Sales, you will build the sales system a fast-growing firm runs on for years and own it end to end: qualification, pipeline, deal progression, close, forecast.

The job

You own the revenue number, and you own the pipeline that backs it. A demand engine produces the leads; you turn them into qualified opportunities and signed engagements, and you generate your own outbound alongside it.

This is a player-coach seat. You close deals yourself while you build the playbook, the enablement library, and eventually the team. We will share the specific Year-1 targets in the first conversation.

What you'll do

Close mid-market and enterprise executives (CEO, CFO, COO) in professional services, manufacturing and distribution, and private equity portfolios
Sell multi-phase engagements that start with AI education and grow into transformation programs with recurring revenue
Build the sales system: qualification bar, stages, forecast discipline, tooling
Finish and field-test the enablement library: talk tracks, battlecards, ROI models
Recruit and manage BDRs and account executives as revenue supports it
Co-sell partner-sourced deals with executives and cross-functional peers

What you bring

4+ years selling technology, digital transformation, or consulting services to mid-market and enterprise executives, with six-figure, multi-phase deals behind you
You have built a sales motion at an early-stage firm: first playbook, first hires, a forecast that held up
You can defend an ROI case to a CFO and a strategy case to a CEO
Working fluency with AI; you will sell transformation you use yourself
Comfort working directly with executives and cross-functional peers, and owning a number without cover

How to apply

Email cosmo@xsparks.ai with your track record: the motion you built, the numbers you carried, and your resume.

Director

Full-time

Job function

Business Development and Sales

Industries
